text_block_list.text:
One day, after winning countless races
together with Agnes Digital—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
is it about time... to execute the plan?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I've seen countless smiles and tears from Umamusume-chans.
With this treasure trove of memories...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Did you forget~?
The hot springs, our hot spring trip. You won
a ticket in the raffle at the start of the year, didn't you?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Three whole years in the Twinkle Series!
Once it's all over, we gotta share
every single memory of the Umamusume!
Of course I haven't forgotten. In terms of timing, this might actually be the perfect moment.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Th-That was surprisingly nonchalant...
I mean, Digi-tan is super thrilled, of course,
but I also feel a twinge of dread...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: No, but if it's you, Trainer, you should be fine! Let us talk through the night about my finest moments.

Though I didn't know what she was so afraid of,
we headed out to the hot springs by train.
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: *gulp*... A heart-to-heart with just Trainer and me...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: It's okay, everything will be fine... All right!
(CLATTER-CLATTER-CLANK!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Pardon the intrusion! Let the fierce, fiery debate—Umamusume-chan Night, begin!
I decided to discuss Umamusume with an unusually fired-up Agnes Digital.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahaha, right?! Man, you should've seen
just how timidly Doto-san went on the offensive back then~

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, just that little gesture made me drool...
And then, and then...!"
choice_data_list: Um, by the way, do you want to eat soon?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Huh? A meal?
But we haven't talked that much yet...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Whaaaaaat,
is it already this late~~~!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: In the blink of an eye?! What is this, some kind of stolen time gimmick...?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
U-U-Uuuu, I can't believe I got
so carried away...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: It seems I was worrying far too much after all. There really was nothing to be afraid of...

After fidgeting shyly,
Agnes Digital began to speak.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Even if we share the same hobbies... it's still kind of
terrifying, you know? Going on a hot spring trip with someone.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
What if we don't find the same things cute?
What if an awkward silence falls between us?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I just couldn't help worrying...
Um... at my core, I have zero communication skills...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Except, guess what!
Once we got started, I couldn't stop talking! I still haven't talked nearly enough!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Do you understand just what a miracle this is,
and what a shock it brings?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I honestly thought a day like this would never come.
And yet...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"I had no idea...
that someone could be on such the same wavelength as me..."

It seems Agnes Digital was
worried about running out of things to talk about.
choice_data_list: I'm so glad I met you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What?! Wh-Wh-What kind of line is that?!
What anime movie did you pull that from?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Dropping something like that with a straight face...
Her social skills are terrifying..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I feel like I could talk for hours with a Trainer like you!
And so, the pleasant conversation continued—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Eeeehk, was that back when I made
my debut? Right? Right?
You actually remember that~?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah-wah, please forget that...!
It's dark history! Officially certified dark history~~!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, didn't this stop being about the Umamusume
and start being about me? And what's more...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Even so, the conversation never dies down...
Isn't this basically party-animal tier...?
choice_data_list: I don't think that's true, though.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: "I totally do, without a doubt! Even though I was a hardcore otaku who could only live for Umamusume..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
“Still, whatever! Anything's fine!
I don't care! As long as you accept
me just the way I am!”

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh...! I just can't stop talking about myself.
Um, um, um, you see...!

As if the floodgates had burst, Agnes Digital
kept talking. The doors to her heart were thrown
as wide open as they could possibly be.

It was a moment where I felt
an irreplaceable bond with Agnes Digital...
